en: The image depicts a black-and-white landscape scene, likely from the early 20th century. In the foreground, there are two people in period clothing (possibly soldiers or hikers) standing on a grassy hill among sparse birch trees. They appear to be gesturing or waving toward the valley below. In the background, a small settlement with a few houses is visible, set in a wooded valley with a rocky hillside to the right and a road running through the scene.
